paragraphs: I am a PMP-certified Technical Program Manager transitioning into AI and cloud engineering through a portfolio of independent, hands-on projects. Using AWS, Google Cloud, and modern AI-assisted development tools, I design, build, test, and document cloud-native applications that demonstrate practical skills in AI integration, cloud architecture, and software development.

My background in education, leadership, and project management enables me to translate complex technical concepts into practical solutions, collaborate with diverse stakeholders, and deliver technology initiatives with a focus on communication, continuous learning, and measurable results.
